graph_discipline: Roots remain nodes; branches are edge or port labels, not graph nodes.

root_resolution.note: The basmala is part of the analysis frame. It reinforces divine agency and sovereign security without adding roots to the supplied branch inventory.

surface_mechanism: The conjunction carries forward the preceding punitive act, while لَا scopes over the imperfect يَخَافُ and negates fear in the acting subject.
عُقْبَٰهَا names what follows the act: its end, outcome, or aftermath, with the feminine suffix referring back to the antecedent event.
The compact clause therefore joins sovereign fearlessness to consequence: the actor neither anticipates harm nor retreats before liability, review, or punitive aftermath.
